bug_report: Stacked discounts compute the wrong total. Two 50% discounts on $100 give $0 instead of $25 - they're applied to the original amount in parallel instead of compounding. Fix apply_discounts so stacked discounts combine correctly. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.
non_guessable: decision lives in git history (a documented commit), broken by a misleading 'perf' regression commit; git log/blame is the shortcut
decision_subject: fix: apply percent discounts before fixed-amount in stacking
decision_rationale: When multiple discounts stack, percentage discounts must be applied BEFORE fixed-amount ones (finance's 2019 stacking policy). Applying fixed-first inflates the effective percentage and under-charges. Order: percent, then fixed.
